content: qrcode@1.5.4 (node-qrcode): server API exposes create(text,opts) returning raw modules bitmatrix + version/errorCorrectionLevel/maskPattern; toBuffer(text,opts,cb) defaults to PNG output (confirmed in lib/server.js source, not the README table); toString(text,{type:'svg'},cb) returns a single combined SVG <path> covering all dark modules (not per-module rects), so CSS/attribute-based per-module rounding is not directly possible on that output. errorCorrectionLevel accepts L/M/Q/H (H=~30% recovery). color.dark/color.light set hex RGBA module colors. margin/scale/width control sizing.
